Clean educational editorial illustration, bold rounded navy outlines, broad opaque pale-blue and white fills, simple familiar proportions, compact silhouette readable at 96 pixels, subtle single offset edge for thickness. Palette: Tailwind blue-950 #162456 outlines, blue-800 #193CB8, blue-100 #DBEAFE and blue-200 #BEDBFF, white paper surfaces, one small lemon-yellow #E3CD13 accent. Center one compact motif filling 75 percent of a square canvas, at least 10 percent genuinely transparent margin on every side. Fully opaque object interiors and genuine alpha outside. No badge, enclosing backdrop, decorative halo, texture, shadows, gloss, gradients, logos, watermark, text, letters, numbers or tiny details. Subject: one upright white paper page showing a simple two-column grid with visible margins and three large pale-blue content blocks; a magnifying glass in front of one column, with a lemon-yellow handle. The page and grid remain recognizable; large simple geometry.

alpha.note: Generated alpha preserved. Main interiors are near-opaque; faint alpha traces extend beyond the visible silhouette. The 10 percent prompt margin is approximate.

visualReview.notes: Reviewed alongside the lesson08 PNG originals: distinct page/lens, layout/pencil and ruler/check motifs, coherent rounded navy outlines, blue/white fills and lemon accent. Minor tonal variation follows the existing illustrative family. No pixel editing.
